definitions.gloss: staying at home on standby; remaining at home as instructed
definitions.explanation: Being required or requested to stay at home and wait for further instructions. Used in workplace, school, and public health contexts, including during infectious disease outbreaks and natural disasters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{自宅|じたく}{待機|たいき}になった。
examples.english: We were told to stay home because of the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{濃厚|のうこう}→濃厚：07905_noukou⟧{接触者|せっしょくしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自宅|じたく}{待機|たいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}められた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Close contacts were asked to stay home and quarantine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{自宅|じたく}{待機|たいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The company issued a stay-at-home order, so I'll be at home until I hear from them.

notes:
USAGE:
Became very common during the COVID-19 pandemic. Also used when employees are suspended from work pending an investigation, or when schools close due to weather.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自宅|じたく}{待機|たいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{命|めい}じられる→命じる：02309_meijiru⟧ (to be ordered to stay home)
- {自宅|じたく}{待機|たいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧ (instruction to stay home)
- {自宅|じたく}{待機|たいき}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (home quarantine period)
- {自宅|じたく}{待機|たいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧ (to request someone stay home)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧⟦{自粛|じしゅく}→自粛：07650_jishuku⟧: voluntarily refraining from going out — a request rather than an order
- ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦{療養|りょうよう}→療養：08207_ryouyou⟧: recovering at home — specifically for medical treatment
